079 note 1 · why is everything glistening?

Cause. The sun's specular on very smooth metals, then the bloom spreading it. DK_Chrome (smoothness 0.95, metallic 1), DK_Steel, and the fountain's gold and silver drew the sun at up to 7072 in linear on single pixels (lit stone is about 1.1); after the fix the peak in the four views is 392, on materials the clamp now holds. The play bloom had no clamp, so one such pixel became a white ball over a car. The leaves added most of the small white points in the planting. Moving the camera a quarter pixel makes those points blink: that's the shimmer.

Fix, no shader code. (1) Sun specular off on DK_Chrome, DK_Steel, DK_Fountain_Gold, DK_Fountain_Silver: the standard URP Lit option, so they keep their mirror reflections. (2) Play bloom clamp 4. (3) DK_Leaf_TB and DK_Petal_TB gloss x 0.5. Colour holds: cafe-y030 mean saturation 0.264 to 0.264, mean luma 184.556 to 184.337; cafe-y210 mean saturation 0.296 to 0.297, mean luma 163.462 to 162.913; office-y030 mean saturation 0.277 to 0.278, mean luma 148.62 to 148.485; office-y210 mean saturation 0.271 to 0.271, mean luma 148.732 to 148.195. Mean frame difference is 1.2 to 1.55 of 255; two runs of the same look differ by 0.73 to 1.0.

Fix candidates

Lowering chrome's smoothness makes it worse: 0.8, 0.65 and 0.5 raise blown pixels (a wider white lobe) and take the mirror away. Turning the sun's specular off is what works.

Not settled

  • The remaining pops look mostly like geometric edges rather than glitter (an inference: they aren't separated by cause). From the as-built look, render scale 2 cut pops by 66 to 88 percent and MSAA 4x by 58 to 84 percent, but MSAA is off on the play camera for frame rate and neither is measured on the Air, so neither is adopted.
  • Office front y030: remaining points are mostly tan flecks in the window glass and the chrome window bars' reflection, not white sun glints.
  • Night and evening: rendered after the fix, points fall (night café y210 541 to 261), nothing broke. The night pair's lamp pools differ because the lamp cap had not settled in the first variant, so night blown counts aren't a clean comparison.
